tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Blueprint Ink. Primary text, the logo, the hub's dominant color. 13.8:1 on primer, 15.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on primer or white (6.8:1 on primer).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Muted text for metadata and helper text on primer or white (4.9:1 on primer). Never below 13px.

tokens.name: chalk-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input borders on white. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: primer
tokens.usage: Primer. Default page background, like a freshly primed wall.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, forms, estimate documents. Text on dark fills marked on-white.

tokens.name: chalk-blue
tokens.usage: Chalk Line Blue. The one parent accent: dimension lines, links, focus rings, selected states. Links on primer 4.7:1. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring offset 2px from the element.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions only. 5.7:1 on primer.

tokens.name: signal-success
tokens.usage: Confirmation messages only (same value as leaf-deep).
